transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Rowan, Maintenance Control Officer. I need to get the quarter-end property reconciliation moving for the items currently tagged as unserviceable — battery packs, rugged tablets, power converters, and electronic test cables. Before I can sign the disposition order, I need current technical status and disposition recommendations confirmed with the responsible sections. Who's here representing the property office, repair bench, and calibration desk?

Property-office pickup is scheduled for Wednesday at 1000. I should note that the inspection sheet is still in our shop binder and has not yet been entered in the maintenance control log — we'll need to get that recorded.
